outcomes.description: For supported postdoctoral fellows: an increased set of research and transferable skills and competences, leading to improved employability and career prospects within academia and beyond.
For supported postdoctoral fellows: new mind-sets and approaches to R&I work forged through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience.
For supported postdoctoral fellows: enhanced networking and communication capacities with scientific peers and with the general public that increase and broaden the research and innovation impact.
For participating organisations: increased alignment of working conditions for researchers in accordance with the principles set out in the European Charter for Researchers.
For participating organisations: enhanced quality and sustainability of research training and supervision.
For participating organisations: increased global attractiveness, visibility and reputation of the participating organisation(s).
For participating organisations: stronger R&I capacity and output among participating organisations and better transfer of knowledge.
For participating organisations: regular feedback of research results into teaching and education at participating organisations.
